Display Jungle Pocket (Jinbei)

Hah? What, you don't get it either?
Good grief...
Alright. —Then get ready.

AHAHAHA! Yeah!! That's the spirit!!
*inhallllles*... TAAAAA-MAAA-YAAAAAA!!!

Damn straight it is! That's a Queen Carrot,
harvested right from our hometown! The sweetness is on a whole 'nother level compared to regular ones!

...I felt like I had stepped that much closer to being the "partner" she wanted.
And that made me proud.
Aw c'mon, what's the harm, partner! Don't be so stingy!

Whoops, right! First off, food—whoa! They got goldfish scooping
too?! Hey, let's have a match! Loser buys cotton candy!

...My bad, alright? I didn't mean anything weird by it.
Just found it kinda curious, is all.

Someone who can stand their ground when push comes to shove.
—I've seen that in them.

Trainer-san's a normie, right?
Isn't that dangerous?

Ever heard of a crew called "Grizzly"?
Word is, this area's their turf.

Seeing the smile on her face, a question crossed my mind—
Why was it me?

By the way, there's a huge festival happening around here tonight!
Us locals are gonna make it wild, so you'd better show up!

A festival?! For real?! Hell yeah, I'm going!
—Hey?! You're coming too, right?!
Hey. Leave it at that.

I gave a firm nod in response. ...Deep down, I felt overjoyed.
I had finally earned Jungle Pocket's trust.

Well, but we're the ones who stepped onto someone else's turf.
Not making things right would be totally lame.
—I can count on you, right? Trainer.
Get it now, partner?

I braced myself so I could act immediately if anything went wrong. At the very least,
I had to make sure Jungle Pocket didn't get hurt...!

...Haha. So you really did come over here, Ogre of Tokyo!
I've heard all about your legends. Wanted to meet ya, y'know?

To be completely honest, I was scared... but as her Trainer,
there was no way I could let Jungle Pocket go alone.

Apparently their head is pissed at me about something. ...Says I didn't
"pay my respects" or whatever? Such a pain in the ass, seriously.
...Heheh! Thought so!
Makes me wanna put my heart in your hands.

It seemed Grizzly was only upset about not receiving a greeting,
and actually held great respect for Jungle Pocket.

Looking forward to working with you from here on out tooooo!!!
Partneeeeer!!! ...Heheh!
Don't butt in. It's my call.
That. You're coming with me, got it?

Didn't think you'd actually show your mug here... heh-heh-heh!
Alright, boys! Let's welcome this outsider our way!

...Anyway, thanks for today!
For coming along with me to Grizzly's place.

Heheh. Hope the fireworks start soon!
How many do you think there'll be? Hope it lasts long!

So yeah.
I'm gonna charge right in and hit 'em with a hello.

You're the "Ogre of Tokyo", right? If so,
you should have someone way less wimpy accompanying you—

Don't go judging 'em as wimpy.
...They're totally badass, y'know? On the inside.
Come to think of it, Grizzly was saying something similar—

...Pokke-san. Like I asked earlier...
Are you seriously sure you don't want us coming along?

Huh? "Someone like that"...
You talking about my Trainer?

Aaah?! Too quiet, too quiet! Can't hear ya with a voice like that!
Put some chest into it, dammit!

Heheh... The Ogre of Tokyo came all the way out to see us!
If we didn't prepare at least this much, our rep would be shot!

Oh! You're really getting into it!
Nice. Let's have ourselves a blast!
You don't wanna have regrets, right?
*nom*

...Mmm!
This is freakin' delicious! C'mon, c'mon, one more bite!

Oh, finally found ya.
—Hey, got a second to talk?

...Soooo goooood! What the heck is this?!
Is this seriously a carrot?! I've never had anything like this before!!

C'mon, over this way!
Someone told me about a sweet secret spot!

...Oh. Is that a chocolate banana?
When'd you buy that? I want some too!

...Hey, mind if I ask you something?
Why do you drag someone like that around with you?

Whoa?! ...Awesome!!
TAAA-MAAA-YAAAA!!!

Well, physical strength-wise? I kinda wish they'd bulk up a bit more, but...
I'm not just making stuff up, okay? For real.

TAAAAA-MAAA-YAAAAAA!!!
C'mon, shout it out! From the gut!

Ohhh! A shooting gallery!! Heheh, it's been a while!
Hey, keep your eyes peeled, got it? I'm taking down the biggest prize there is!
—You guys the ones called "Grizzly"?
